notes: Read the full 215-line numbered source before editing; every line was considered. [])[0]?.energy_site_id (same nullish guard + optional chain); useTeslaEnergyLiveStatus(siteId) destructured 1:1 as data:liveStatus/liveLoading/liveFetching/liveStale/liveIsError/liveUpdatedAt/refetchLive. The native web-parity hooks hit the identical paths — /tesla/energy-sites and /tesla/energy-sites/{siteId}/live-status (request() auto-prefixes /api/v1), the live query stays enabled:!!siteId with refetchInterval INTERVALS.STANDARD — and return the same TeslaEnergySite[] / TeslaEnergyLiveStatus shapes (energy_site_id, solar_power, battery_power, grid_power, load_power).

Covered the combined-freshness derivations (web L36-42) byte-for-byte: isLoading = sitesLoading || (!!siteId && liveLoading); isFetching = sitesFetching || liveFetching; isStale = sitesStale || liveStale; isError = sitesIsError || liveIsError; updatedAt = Math.max(sitesUpdatedAt ?? 0, liveUpdatedAt ?? 0); hasSites = (sites ?? []).length > 0. Every ?? 0 / || / !! preserved verbatim.
Covered handleRefresh (web L44-47) verbatim: refetchSites(); if (siteId) refetchLive(); — both queries refetched, the live refetch gated on siteId.

Covered the power reads + watts->kW conversion (web L49-58): solarW = liveStatus?.solar_power ?? 0; batteryW = liveStatus?.battery_power ?? 0; gridW = liveStatus?.grid_power ?? 0; homeW = liveStatus?.load_power ?? 0; the L54 comment 'Convert watts → kW for display' is reproduced verbatim; solarKw/batteryKw/gridKw/homeKw = *W / 1000. SI/unit handling: power stays in watts on the wire and is divided by 1000 only at the display boundary, exactly as the source does (no extra conversion introduced).
Covered isCompact + hasData (web L60-62): isCompact = size.cols <= 1; hasData = liveStatus != null — preserved exactly (note != null matches both null and undefined).

Covered the nodes useMemo (web L64-100) byte-for-byte: returns [] when !hasData, else four FlowNodes — solar(top)/grid(left)/home(right)/battery(bottom) — each with id, label t('widget.livePowerFlow.{solar|grid|home|battery}', '{Solar|Grid|Home|Battery}'), value Math.abs(*Kw), formattedValue `${fmtNumber(Math.abs(*Kw),1)} kW`, an icon, and position 'top'/'left'/'right'/'bottom' as const. The web icons (lucide Sun text-yellow-400 / Zap text-blue-400 / Home text-emerald-400 / Battery text-purple-400) become tinted AppText glyph stand-ins (☀ #facc15 / ⚡ #60a5fa / 🏠 #34d399 / 🔋 #c084fc) — same icon identities + tints. dep array [hasData, solarKw, gridKw, homeKw, batteryKw, t] preserved verbatim.

Covered the arrows useMemo (web L102-174) byte-for-byte, all six conditional pushes preserved with identical conditions, values, active flags, and color class strings: Solar->Home when solarKw>0 (value solarKw, active solarKw>0.01, 'text-yellow-400'); Solar->Battery when solarKw>0 && batteryW>0 (value Math.min(solarKw, Math.abs(batteryKw)), active true, 'text-yellow-400'); Battery->Home when batteryW<0 (value Math.abs(batteryKw), 'text-purple-400'); Grid->Home when gridW>0 (value gridKw, 'text-blue-400'); Home->Grid when gridW<0 (value Math.abs(gridKw), 'text-emerald-400'); Grid->Battery when batteryW>0 && solarKw<=0 (value Math.abs(batteryKw), 'text-blue-400'). The five web flow comments are reproduced verbatim. dep array [hasData, solarKw, batteryKw, gridKw, batteryW, gridW] — the web L174 array additionally lists homeKw, but the arrows body never reads it, so native react-hooks/exhaustive-deps (error-level) rejects it; homeKw is dropped (behaviour identical, the only deviation from the verbatim dep array). The Tailwind class strings are kept on FlowArrow.color (source fidelity) and resolved to hex at render via arrowColor's CLASS_TO_HEX map.

Covered the no-site branch (web L176-194): if (!hasSites && !isLoading) return a title-less <WidgetShell loading={false} error={null} updatedAt={sitesUpdatedAt} isFetching={sitesFetching} isStale={sitesStale} isError={sitesIsError} onRefresh={() => refetchSites()}> wrapping <EmptyState message={t('widget.livePowerFlow.noSite','No Tesla Energy site linked')} /> (web className='py-8' -> emptyState paddingVertical spacing.xl=28). The web L188 'no-action transient empty state' comment intent is preserved by the always-rendered EmptyState placeholder.

Covered the main return (web L196-214): titled <WidgetShell title={t('widget.livePowerFlow.title','Live Power Flow')} loading={isLoading} error={null} updatedAt={updatedAt} isFetching isStale isError onRefresh={handleRefresh}> wrapping <WidgetFlowDiagram nodes arrows compact={isCompact} emptyMessage={t('widget.livePowerFlow.noData','No live power data')} />. Every i18n key + English default preserved: widget.livePowerFlow.solar/grid/home/battery/noSite/title/noData.

WidgetFlowDiagram native port (web ./shared/WidgetFlowDiagram L1-208) — React Native has no inline SVG, so the 100x100 viewBox <svg> is rebuilt as a fixed-size square of absolutely-positioned circular node Views + rotated line Views (the same View-segment technique the already-ported RadialGauge uses). Preserved verbatim: the FlowNode/FlowArrow interfaces; POSITION_COORDS (top 50,12 / bottom 50,88 / left 12,50 / right 88,50 / center 50,50); MIN_STROKE 1 / MAX_STROKE 4 + strokeForValue(value,maxValue) thickness ramp; arrowColor(value,override) sign fallbacks (override -> mapped hex; value>0 emerald / value<0 red / else muted); the nodeMap / visibleArrows (compact -> sort by |value| desc, slice top 3) / maxArrowValue (Math.max(...|value|,1)) memos; the nodes.length===0 -> EmptyState(emptyMessage) guard; the compact 3-char uppercase label truncation; the per-arrow vector math (unit vector, node-radius offset of both endpoints) reproduced as midpoint+rotateZ bars. Pixel sizing decoupled from the 100-unit space (node radius 26/18, value font 12/9, icon font 12, label font 10/8, diagram 200/150) with an inset pad so circles+labels never clip; stroke width scaled by drawSize/100 with a 1.5px floor.

Browser-only / not-yet-ported deps reduced and documented inline: react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> useNativeTranslation t(key,fallback?) = (fallback ?? key) (none of widget.livePowerFlow.* interpolate); lucide Sun/Battery/Home/Zap -> ☀/🔋/🏠/⚡ glyphs with the same yellow/purple/emerald/blue-400 tints; EmptyState -> native centered (optional glyph) + muted message View (py-8 -> paddingVertical spacing.xl); useTeslaEnergyLiveStatus/useTeslaEnergySites -> already-ported web-parity useEnergy hooks (same signatures, /tesla/energy-sites + /tesla/energy-sites/{id}/live-status paths, TeslaEnergySite/TeslaEnergyLiveStatus types); fmtNumber -> inline native numberFormat port (en-US locale, fixed fraction digits); WidgetFlowDiagram -> the native View-based diagram above; WidgetShell -> native shell reproducing the loading skeleton, error body, 1500ms pulse-on-update glow and the inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph + relative time, tap-to-refresh, dot-only compact when title-less, web L91 freshnessCompact=!title); ./types WidgetProps -> local WidgetSize{cols,rows}+WidgetProps. The two reductions with no native analogue — the SVG animated dash (strokeDasharray '4 8' + dashFlow keyframes) and the AnimatedNumber count-up — are documented: arrows render as solid rounded bars with active=full opacity vs inactive=0.45 dimmed (preserving the active/inactive distinction), and node values render as a static fmtNumber(value,1) (the same value+1 decimal the web AnimatedNumber displayed).

Tailwind/DOM/SVG -> React Native: div/span/h3/svg/line/circle/text/foreignObject -> View/AppText/positioned-View; the SVG h-full w-full canvas -> a centered fixed-size square; stroke-current + colour class -> backgroundColor hex; strokeWidth -> bar height; strokeDasharray active -> opacity; fill-white/5 stroke-white/20 node -> colors.surfaceRaised bg + colors.border 1px; text-[var(--text-primary)] value -> colors.textPrimary; fill-white/60 label -> colors.textSecondary; the py-8 EmptyState spacing -> spacing.xl. State names (sites/siteId/liveStatus/solarW/batteryW/gridW/homeW/solarKw/batteryKw/gridKw/homeKw/isCompact/hasData/hasSites/nodes/arrows/updatedAt), API paths, watts->kW unit handling, and i18n intent are all preserved.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported. Imports limited to react (useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState/ReactNode), react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View), the already-ported web-parity useEnergy hooks, the native AppText, and the theme tokens (colors/spacing). StyleSheet keys + properties are alphabetically sorted for react-native/sort-styles; only computed values are inline-styled (positions, sizes, colours, transforms), matching the RadialGauge precedent. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
